name: bezotcorp-ai
description: Configurable AI coding assistant for VS Code.

bezotcorpAi.provider.description: AI provider used by BezotCorp AI.

bezotcorpAi.providerUrl.description: Provider URL. Ollama default is http://127.0.0.1:11434. Custom backend default is usually http://127.0.0.1:4188.

bezotcorpAi.model.description: Model name used by the selected provider.

bezotcorpAi.contextMode.description: Context mode. Basic sends focused context. Rich sends more workspace information.

enumDescriptions: Only read and search tools are available.
Everything except reading inside the workspace asks for permission unless already granted.
File changes inside the workspace go ahead without asking; commands, network and MCP still ask.
Nothing asks, except operations matched by an ask rule. Deny rules always apply. Choose this explicitly.
bezotcorpAi.autonomyMode.description: How much the AI may do on its own. Only read from user settings.

bezotcorpAi.permissions.markdownDescription: What the AI may do with each tool, by tool identity, kept for every workspace: `{ "edit_file": "allow", "git_push": "deny" }`. Values: `allow` (no question), `ask` (confirm at each call), `deny` (the tool is not offered and cannot run). A tool without an entry uses its default: reading and consulting tools allow, the others ask. MCP tools are named `mcp__server__tool`. Use the command *BezotCorp AI: Manage Permissions* to edit this per session, workspace or globally. Only read from user settings.

bezotcorpAi.protectedPaths.markdownDescription: Extra protected resources, added to the built-in ones (`.env`, `.env.*`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `id_rsa*`, `.npmrc`, `.git`, `.ssh`, `.aws`...). A protected resource is never read, changed, moved or deleted without asking, whatever a tool is allowed to do, and stays out of the context, searches and git output. A bare name or glob matches at any depth; `//abs/path`, `~/path` and `path` (from the workspace root) are also accepted.

bezotcorpAi.contextTokens.description: Context window requested from the model, in tokens (num_ctx for Ollama). It bounds how much conversation history is sent. The model's own maximum applies when lower.

bezotcorpAi.mcpServers.description: MCP servers started over stdio, keyed by name: { "name": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "server"], "env": {}, "cwd": "" } }. Only read from user settings.
